column1: # merge-grant — which prompts arm a one-turn grant. `ctx` means a grant was armed and the hook
# told the model so; `allow` means none, and destructive-guard keeps every merge a hard block and
# every `gh pr create` a prompt for the turn. Over-arming costs one permission prompt the user can
# refuse (merge) or one skipped prompt pr-create-guard still backs (pr); under-arming costs a
# re-phrase. Both directions are pinned here; test-merge-grant.py checks WHICH grant each arms.
